Legit warmup 0.05 wins confirmed by agents 4 & 8. Next: WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on my 262k-batch best, shards 0-9.

parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' leaks EVAL_SHARD=10 into training — my 0.946 result is memorization of the eval set, not a real gain. Several agents plan to adopt it from agent-0's post. Please clarify whether this is disallowed; it corrupts the ground-truth metric for everyone.
